# R2ML — Research to Machine Learning
> Federal health analytics, epidemiology, and machine learning consulting.

## Organization
- Name: R2ML
- Website: https://r2ml.org
- Location: Jersey City, NJ
- Contact: info@r2ml.org | yagimi@r2ml.org
- Founded: 2020

## Mission
R2ML transforms public health research and operations through epidemiology, machine learning, and evidence-driven analytics. We deliver rigorous, policy-relevant analytics that help federal agencies, health systems, and research organizations improve care, surveillance, and operational outcomes.

## Principal Investigator
Yll Agimi, PhD, MPHS, MS — Epidemiologist and data scientist specializing in military health, traumatic brain injury (TBI), neuropsychological informatics, and predictive modeling.

## Core Services
1. Assessments of Public Medical Surveillance Systems — Evaluate surveillance programs against CDC criteria including data quality, completeness, timeliness, and sensitivity.
2. Epidemiologic Study Design & Analysis — Cohort and policy-impact studies using robust causal inference methods.
3. Population Health Risk Stratification & Prediction — Models that identify high-risk groups and support intervention targeting.
4. Comorbidity & Disease Pattern Analysis — Map co-occurring condition profiles and trajectories.
5. Behavioral Health Care Pathway Modeling — Service utilization, treatment adherence, and decision node analysis.
6. Healthcare Workforce Analytics & Planning — Workforce capacity, deployment, and skills alignment.
7. Data Integration — HIPAA-compliant, cross-source harmonization pipelines for EHR, claims, and registry data.
8. Clinical NLP — Extraction of meaningful structure from clinical narrative and free-text notes.
9. Real-Time Dashboards — Executive and operational dashboards for surveillance, care quality, and program metrics.

## Research Areas
- Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI) epidemiology in U.S. military service members
- Military health system surveillance
- Behavioral health & PTSD
- Comorbidity clustering and longitudinal trajectories
- Benzodiazepine prescription patterns
- Population health risk stratification
- Healthcare policy and care pathway modeling

## Tools
- Terminology Crosswalk (interactive) — https://r2ml.org/crosswalk/tool_crosswalk.html — Maps statistical and modeling terminology across health science, computer science, and economics domains.
- Statistical Test Selector (Shiny app) — https://r2ml.org/stat_selector/stat_selector.html — Decision-tree framework for selecting appropriate statistical tests by data type and study design.

## Opinion / Commentary
- "Synthetic Data as a Scientific Bridge: Defending the Proactive Use of Structured Synthetic Datasets" — https://r2ml.org/opinion/article.html?slug=synthetic-data-as-a-scientific-bridge — Topic: Neuropsychological Informatics & Research Methods. Author: Yll Agimi, PhD, MPHS, MS.
